description: Provider-neutral capability profiles for SecondBrain task routing. Profile names describe the capability needed; harness adapters may map them to current models and reasoning settings.

profiles.title: No language model
profiles.description: A deterministic command, transformation, or inspection can complete the request without semantic judgement.
escalate_when: The request needs interpretation, synthesis, or ambiguous policy judgement.

profiles.title: Routine
profiles.description: A bounded, low-ambiguity task with clear inputs, outputs, authority, and inexpensive validation.
escalate_when: Required context is unavailable or exceeds the packet.
The task reveals material ambiguity, consequential risk, or a missing acceptance check.

profiles.title: Balanced
profiles.description: Bounded implementation, analysis, or synthesis that needs considered judgement but has explicit ownership and acceptance checks.
escalate_when: The work becomes cross-domain, materially ambiguous, or consequential beyond the declared acceptance checks.
A required validator, authority, or source is missing.

profiles.title: Strong
profiles.description: Difficult synthesis, consequential ambiguity, or high-value judgement where lower profiles would create avoidable correction or escalation risk.
escalate_when: The user must make a decision outside the packet's delegated authority.
Evidence is insufficient for a consequential recommendation.
